height.location: Approximate overall cryostat height, CCS-400 column of the CCR vacuum cryostats datasheet; published as a range 61 to 89 cm (depends on cold head ordered), upper bound given here.

width_or_diameter.location: Square window block at the sample end of the vacuum shroud (the only published lateral dimension; 83 mm to 85 mm square). The diameter of the main cylindrical vacuum shroud above the block is NOT published; see not_found.
width_or_diameter.quote: Window block size ... 83 mm to 85 mm (3.25 in to 3.75 in) square

outer.color_note: Datasheet photos show a bare metal vacuum shroud ending in a square window block, cold head on top, sample at the bottom; shroud finish is not described in text. Weight (approximate) 16 to 30 kg (36 to 65 lb) for the CCS-400 column.

stages.name: cold head first stage (radiation shield anchor). Temperature from the SHI RDK-408D2, the 1 W at 4.2 K Gifford-McMahon head matching Lake Shore option 408; Lake Shore itself publishes no first-stage temperature (inference, see notes)
stages.quote: 1 st Stage Capacity | 40 W @ 43 K | 50 W @ 43 K

stages.name: cold head second stage / sample mount (408 head, 1 W at 4.2 K), bottom of the cold finger inside the window block; <4 K to 500 K with integrated control heater
stages.quote: CCS-400 Optical, high-temperature (500 K), vacuum ... 408 <4 K ... 408 1 W at 4.2 K bare head cooling power

sample_space.shape: sample holder bolted to the bottom of the cold finger (second stage), in vacuum, surrounded by the radiation shield and the 83-85 mm square window block of the bottom-loading shroud
sample_space.description: Sample in vacuum, bottom-loading: shroud and shield are removed from below to reach the sample holder (SH-BLANK-1.5-STD, SH-OPTICAL-1.5-STD, SH-RESISTIVITY-1.5-STD; '-800' high-temperature holders for the 400H). Sample holder footprint and sample-space height are not published in the datasheet; see not_found.

notes: Lake Shore (Environment by Janis) CCS-400: optical, high-temperature (500 K), sample-in-vacuum, bottom-loading closed-cycle refrigerator cryostat, <4 K to 500 K with the 408 cold head (1 W at 4.2 K), typical stability +/-50 mK, cooldown 1.5 h to 3 h (CCS-400 column). Datasheet column mapping (CCS-100 / 300S / 300ST / 400 / 400H) was read from pdftotext layout: height 56-84 / 71-99 / 71-99 / 61-89 / 66-94 cm; weight 16-30 kg; window block 83-85 mm square for CCS-100 and CCS-400 (38 mm square for CCS-300S). The cold head is a required ordering choice (204, 204N, 101, 408, 415, 418); this scene assumes the 408 as the catalog file does. Lake Shore does not name the cold head maker; the '408 / 1 W at 4.2 K' spec matches the SHI RDK-408D2 two-stage GM cryocooler (557 x 180 x 294 mm, 18 kg, <3.5 K, first stage 40/50 W at 43 K), used here only for the first-stage temperature and flagged as an inference. Every cryostat ships with a Lake Shore temperature controller and calibrated sensor; sample wiring (WH-10P etc.) and windows are ordered separately, so dc/coax counts are 0 in this standard configuration. Moving parts: GM displacer in the cold head (rate not published), remote water-cooled helium compressor, external vacuum pump; no magnet, no VSM, no liquid cryogen. Sources: ccr-vacuum.pdf (code 102126), cryostat-feedthroughs product page, cryostatwindows.pdf, shicryogenics.com RDK-408D2 page.
